whatToWatch.text: The Lumen defense is the headliner: Seattle's allowing just 17.9 points per game at 4-3, and a home crowd behind a unit getting 2.4 sacks a week is exactly how you make a Sunday miserable for Chicago.

Watch the injury report closely — Seattle has one player out and four questionable, with Rashid Shaheed, Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet among the names in question. Chicago's dealing with two outs of its own in Anthony Johnson Jr. and Kyle Monangai, so depth could decide this one.

Vegas says Seahawks by 3 with a 46.5 total — tight game, modest scoring expected. The Bears get after the quarterback at 2.7 sacks per game and give up 20.4 points, so protection up front and a clean, efficient day could be the difference in stretching this win streak to two.

newsBlurb.text: Lumen Field hosts the Bears on Monday night, and the Week 8 spotlight belongs entirely to Seattle. Chicago walks into the loudest building in the league with no Sunday crowd noise to hide behind — a standalone national window, one game, full volume.
